english: When we [got] home, [someone] [has broken] [into] the house.
def: When we [got] home, [someone] [has broken] [into] the house.

english: She [had] [went] to bed [before] I [called].
def: She [had] [went] to bed [before] I [called].

english: I had never seen snow before I went to Japan.
def: I had never seen snow before I went to Japan.

english: By the time we arrived, the party had ended.
def: By the time we arrived, the party had ended.
draft: By the time introduce un punto de referencia posterior en el pasado, así que el acontecimiento anterior usa el pasado perfecto had ended.

english: The ground was wet because it ___ all night.
english_example: rained | has rained | had been raining | was rain
def: The ground was wet because it ___ all night.
draft: La lluvia continuó antes del resultado pasado, así que usa had been raining.

english: She was exhausted because she ___ all day.
english_example: was travel | has travelled | travelled | had been travelling
def: She was exhausted because she ___ all day.

english: They ___ for thirty minutes when the doctor called them in.

english: By the time the guests arrive, we ___ dinner.
